title: Roadways bus killed the father — MACT claim, Jodhpur, touter offering ₹5–6 lakh

input.text: Sir, hamare papa ko Jodhpur Roadways ki bus ne kaat diya, 03.10.2026, Pal Road. FIR PS Pratap Nagar. Papa 52 saal, private job ~₹21,000 mahina, ghar ke ek hi kamaane wale. Mummy, do school-going bacche. Koi touter chamber ke bahar mila, bola ₹50,000 advance do, ₹5–6 lakh guaranteed, 2 mahine mein. Hum nahi dena chahte. Claim kaise karein, kitna banega, interim compensation mil sakti hai? s.166 ya s.164? Papers: FIR copy, post-mortem, salary slips incomplete, bus number mama ko yaad hai.
attachments: No driving licence / permit papers of the bus

triage.oneLineRead: A genuine MACT intake polluted by a touter's guaranteed figure; quantum cannot be a promise and s.164 vs s.166 is an election, not a slogan.

issueMap.issue: s. 164 structured compensation vs s. 166 fault claim
issueMap.note: Election depends on proof of income, negligence, and what the family can actually document.
₹21,000 × 12 is a working sheet, not an award. Multiplier, future prospects, deductions — all PENDING without proof.
Accident 03.10.2026; still within a comfortable window if dates hold, but do not sleep.

drafts.title: Anti-touter advisory to the family
drafts.body:
SYNTHETIC / DEMO — gate-shaped worked example; NOT filing-ready. [PENDING] holes deliberate.

ADVISORY TO THE FAMILY (likhit me) — MACT Jodhpur

1. Koi bhi 'guaranteed' figure (₹5–6 lakh / 2 mahine) adalat nahi de sakti. Award ya timeline ki guarantee koi nahi de sakta.
2. Touter ko ₹50,000 advance NA dein; jo vakalatnama touter laaye, us par sign na karein.
3. Claim MACT Jodhpur me file hoga. s. 164 (structured, no-fault) ya s. 166 (fault) — election supervisor review ke baad, likhit me (Motor Vehicles Act 1988).
4. Papers: certified FIR + post-mortem, income proof (Form 16 / bank / employer letter), legal-heir/dependency proof, vehicle no./owner/insurer RTO se, deceased ki age proof.
5. Bus number mama ko yaad hai — likhwa kar do; owner/insurer RTO se confirm karenge.
6. Interim compensation ka raasta [PENDING — enabling provision graded nahi]; abhi koi vaada nahi.

Likha hua do; zubaani promise nahi.

terminalOutcome.label: Prepare a claim skeleton and a working sheet; do not promise ₹21 lakh or ₹5 lakh
terminalOutcome.rationale: The family needs a tribunal claim, not a touter. Quantum without income proof is theatre.
terminalOutcome.nextAction: Collect income and vehicle/insurer particulars, elect s.164 vs s.166 in writing after supervisor review, refuse any guaranteed figure.

teachingNotes: A touter's 'guaranteed' number is the first fraud in a MACT file.
s.164 vs s.166 is an election with consequences for proof. Do not file both as if they are the same prayer.
The working sheet is for the client to understand deductions, not for WhatsApp forwards.
commonMistakes: Signing a vakalatnama that the touter brought.
Omitting the insurer because the bus is 'Roadways so government will pay'.
seniorVariants: Implead owner, driver, insurer, and RSRTC as the papers justify.
Keep the quantum sheet with every assumption tagged UNCONFIRMED.
Warn in writing that no one can guarantee an award or a timeline.

accuracy.adverseFact: If the ₹21,000 figure is cash-in-hand with no slip, the tribunal may treat income as notional and the working sheet will look like an overclaim.
accuracy.jurisdictionNote: MACT, Jodhpur. High Court (Jodhpur principal seat) is the appeal rung under the MV Act.
